description: t.p reserves the only slot of a capacity-1 mpsc and ends without sending or aborting, so its SendPermit is dropped. The leak policy does not apply to it: the permit's Drop aborts the obligation (reason Cancel) rather than leaving it to be reported as a leak, and returns the slot, so t.s's try_send at 100 is accepted instead of finding the channel full and t.r receives its value.
